answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose secret underlies their rate-limit proofs. For each message, a Semaphore-style proof binds an epoch-scoped nullifier to a polynomial evaluation without exposing identity. Reusing the nullifier beyond the allowed rate exposes Shamir shares; interpolation recovers the private key, allowing the network to verify the violation and slash collateral immediately. The echo of that breach warns others, while opal-bright commitments keep accountability within the epoch horizon.
